Job Title: AI Engineer 
Company: null
Location: 7 Makara, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Level: Medium Level
Years of Experience: 2 Year +
Qualification: Bachelor
Salary: $1000 - $2000

Job Responsibilities:
AI Platform & Integration Engineering
• Configure, deploy, and maintain integrations between AITranx products (Gateway, Box, Agents, Enterprise AI) and customer or internal environments (APIs, databases, enterprise applications, LLM providers).
• Support platform reliability, testing, and technical documentation for deployed AI integrations.
• Work with the Technical Director and Engineering team to troubleshoot integration issues and feed real deployment learnings back into product and platform improvements.
Applied AI Solution Design
• Design practical AI architectures (multi-vendor gateway integration, on-prem AI appliance deployment, AI agents, enterprise system integration) tailored to specific business use cases.
• Build and deliver proof-of-concepts (POCs) and technical demonstrations that show how AITranx products solve real business problems.
• Translate business requirements — gathered directly or via the Solutions/Presales team — into technical specifications and implementation plans.
Technical Ownership & Collaboration
• Work directly with the Technical Director on technical standards, architecture decisions, and platform roadmap input.
• Partner with Solutions/Presales, Product, and Delivery teams to ensure proposed and delivered solutions are technically sound and feasible to build.
• Document technical designs, integration patterns, and lessons learned to build reusable internal knowledge.
• Stay current on AITranx product updates and the broader AI/LLM landscape (new model providers, RAG techniques, agent frameworks) to keep designs and integrations technically current.
• The opportunity to work at the center of enterprise AI transformation, building and applying AI across banking, telecom, government, and large enterprise use cases.
• Direct mentorship from the Technical Director and hands-on ownership across a full AI product suite (Gateway, Box, Agents, Enterprise AI).
• A fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with a clear growth path toward Senior Applied AI Engineer / Technical Lead.
• Competitive salary, performance incentives, and a collaborative, multi-cultural team.

Job Requirements & Qualifications:
Must-Have
• 2–3 years of experience in a technical/solutions engineering, systems integration, applied engineering,
or DevOps-adjacent role (IT, cloud, telecom, or software industry).
• Hands-on experience with APIs, system integration, and enterprise IT infrastructure (cloud and/or on
premises).
• Working knowledge of AI/LLM concepts and architecture (e.g., API gateways, RAG, AI agents, vector
databases), with willingness to go deeper hands-on.
• Demonstrated ability to understand and map business/operational process flows (e.g., customer service, document
processing, approval or back-office workflows) and identify practical points for AI integration.
• Ability to both build technical integrations yourself and communicate designs clearly to technical and
non-technical stakeholders.
• Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, and supporting customer-facing technical
discussions when needed.
• Good command of English (spoken and written); Khmer fluency preferred for local market engagement.
Nice-to-Have
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or on-premises infrastructure/data center projects.
• Familiarity with AI/LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen), RAG pipelines, or vector
databases.
• Scripting or programming skills (e.g., Python, API testing with Postman) for integration and validation
work.
• Experience supporting technical presales, tenders, or enterprise deployments in banking, telecom,
government, or large enterprise sectors.
